basis: Existing private git helper is sole shared synchronous blob reader at validate-console-truth-ledger.mjs:50 and currently has default1MiB output bound. Fixed16MiB option does not change commands, signature validation, source path/mode checks, authority-only diff or marker detection.

createConsoleCandidateSourceResolver invokes real git show for authority marker scan and returns candidate readText backed by same helper. Existing signed local Git fixtures can exercise both actual readers without mocks.

Late marker test must specifically expect unresolved merge marker (not generic throw), so old ENOBUFS does not count as intended refusal. Positive control must compare full bytes/hash and tail beyond1MiB.

Overflow must exercise actual readText or authority scan above16MiB and require failclosed; a truncated prefix must never be returned. Existing readText intentionally maps subprocess failure to candidate source missing, which is preserved.
Finite synchronous memory increase is accepted for demonstrated source size. Above16MiB remains a measured trigger for separately reviewed streaming reader rather than silently removing limit.
test_requirements: Real SSH-signed candidate and direct authority-child commits with existing test signing policy and fixtures.
Marker-free authority ledger >1MiB; resolver must construct, then return full candidate blob including late suffix.
Marker after1MiB in authority ledger must produce unresolved merge marker refusal.
Above16MiB source blob read must throw; do not accept nonempty truncated return.
Do not alter existing3ENOBUFS cases or fixture assertions to manufacture green.
limits: Design approval only; exact additive test bytes require independent review before root admission.
No implementation, repository edit or product/runtime tests by this review.
